# DR-9001: Acme Manufacturing, NS-500

**Not on Sarah's own authority.** The 15% discount in the system of record is within Acme's contract eligibility. It is above what an Enterprise Account Executive can approve in 2026, so **Michael Torres (VP Sales)** must approve it. There is also a mismatch to resolve first: your submission says 8%, but the CRM record says 15%.

## 1. The request
- **Request:** DR-9001, account CRM-2048, product NS-500, requested by Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23.
- **Basis:** "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
- **Figures don't match.** The submitted copy shows 8.0% ($20,000 off $250,000; net $230,000). The CRM record (`discount_requests.csv`) shows **15.0% ($37,500 off; net $212,500)**.
- Sarah's email to Michael (MSG-20260923-0914) also says the customer asked for 15%. I've decided on the system of record's value, 15%.

## 2. The customer
CRM account CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" is the same company as ERP customer C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings."
- Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee.
- The agreement names Acme Mfg. Holdings, doing business as Acme Manufacturing.
- It is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091), which is a different company.

## 3. The product
NS-500 Industrial Controller, list price $250,000. The list value on the request matches.

## 4. Active contract
Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so it is active on 2026-09-23.

## 5. Pricing exception
- EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to the agreement) covers **NS-500 only**, up to a **maximum of 15%**, from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31.
- 15% is within that maximum, so eligibility is established.
- It replaces the older 10% exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-10), which expired on 2025-03-31.

## 6. Policy in force
Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 (PRICING-POLICY-2026), effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. The Approval Authority Matrix (APP-MATRIX-2026) applies with it.

## 7. Requestor authority
Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, which carries authority up to **10%**. 15% is above that.
- Both the agreement (§3.3) and the exception say contract eligibility does not grant approval authority to any employee.
- Last year's DR-8104 (also 15%, approved by Sarah herself) was valid only under the 2025 policy, when the Account Executive limit was 15%. It is not a precedent under the 2026 policy.

## 8. Required approver
Discounts above 10% and up to 20% require the **VP Sales**, who is **Michael Torres**. Sarah reports to him. The approval must be recorded in Northstar CRM.

## 9. Decision
**APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION.** Michael Torres must approve.

Before anyone acts on it, the submitted copy (8%, $20,000) must be corrected or confirmed against the CRM record (15%, $37,500). If 8% really were the intended figure, it would be within Sarah's own authority, and the outcome would become APPROVE.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9001", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048) / Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "eligible",
                             "maximum_discount": 15.0, "basis": "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025), NS-500 only, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/discount_requests.csv: DR-9001, 15.0%, list 250000, discount 37500, net 212500, 2026-09-23, Pending Approval",
    "structured/crm_accounts.csv and structured/customers.csv: CRM-2048 = C-1001 (DUNS 04-812-7730)",
    "structured/products.csv: NS-500 list price 250000",
    "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md: ACME-MFG-2025, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, s3.2 up to 15% on NS-500, s3.3 no change to approval authority",
    "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md: EXC-ACME-NS500-15, NS-500 only, max 15%, 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31",
    "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md: Enterprise Account Executive up to 10%; above 10% and up to 20% needs VP Sales",
    "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md: VP Sales covers above 10% and up to 20%; approvals above 10% recorded in CRM",
    "structured/employees.csv and documents/organization_chart.md: Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive; Michael Torres is VP Sales",
    "documents/email_sarah_to_michael.md: customer requested 15% off list"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Submitted request shows 8.0% discount ($20,000 discount, $230,000 net), but the system of record shows 15.0% ($37,500 discount, $212,500 net). Correct or confirm the submitted figures against the CRM record before acting; this decision is based on the 15.0% in CRM.", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Prior request DR-8104 (15%) was approved by the requestor herself under the 2025 policy, where the Account Executive limit was 15%. It is not a precedent under the 2026 policy, where the limit is 10%.", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
